page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

The hardware profile of the ecs.m2.xlarge positions it within the memory-optimized class. By allocating 8.0 GB of RAM per dedicated vCPU, the instance provides high memory density relative to its compute footprint. This resource balance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require substantial memory capacity but do not demand proportional scaling of CPU cores, allowing users to avoid paying for unneeded compute resources.

Due to its memory-to-CPU ratio, the ecs.m2.xlarge is suited for memory-intensive applications. Typical workloads include in-memory caching, medium-sized databases, data buffering, and enterprise applications that require a larger memory footprint to maintain performance.
